Subject (in full) Particulars and movements of two persons who visited Convict
No.2915 Tseu Kwei Ling (周奎麟) at Ward Road Gaol on May 10, 1933.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshanaky Forwarded by O.B. Ru. D.I.

At 3.25 p.m. on May 10, 1933, a telephone message
was received from the Municipal Gaol informing us that visitors
were waiting to interview a political prisoner No.2915 named
Tseu Kwei Ling (周奎麟).

Shortly after the receipt of the message, the under-
signed proceeded to the Gaol, accompanied by C.D.S.96. On
arrival two male Chinese of the student type were allowed to
interview the convict. One gave his name as Lee Pah Bang (李伯彭)
and informed the Gaol clerk that he is a friend of the convict
and gave his address as No.12 Tien Tuh Li (天德里), Hai Zao
Road (海潮路), Nantao. The other visitor gave his name as
Oong Choen Sung (翁南生), Broker No.78 Shanghai Stock Exchange.

The descriptions of the two men are as follows:-
1) Male, aged about 20, height about 5 feet, sallow complexion,
wearing grey long gown, foreign style trousers.
2) Male, aged about 17 or 18 years, height about 5 feet, sallow
complexion, wearing a grey long gown and pair of basket shoes

On leaving the Gaol at the termination of the visit
they boarded a Route No.8 tramcar and alighted at the corner of
Avenue Edward VII and the Bund. Both then walked along Avenue
Edward VII to Szechuen Road, where they entered No.1 Szechuen
Road, these premises are occupied by the Chartered Stock and
Produce Exchange. The men had not left this building at 5.30p.m.
when the watch terminated. It is suspected that both are
employed at the above premises.

D. S. Tcheremshanaky
D. S.

MAY 15 1933 Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 1933年5月10日在华德路监狱探访罪犯第2915号 Tseu Kwei Ling（周奎麟）的两人的详情及动向。
由 D.S. Tcheremshanaky 制作 由 O.B. Ru. 督察 转呈

1933年5月10日下午3点25分，接到市立监狱的电话通知，告知有访客等待会见政治犯第2915号，名为 Tseu Kwei Ling（周奎麟）。

收到消息后不久，签署人会同 C.D.S.96 前往监狱。到达后，两名学生模样的中国男子获准会见该罪犯。一人自称李伯彭（Lee Pah Bang），并告知监狱职员他是罪犯的朋友，其地址为南市海潮路天德里12号。另一名访客自称翁南生（Oong Choen Sung），上海证券交易所经纪人第78号。

这两名男子的描述如下：-
1) 男性，年龄约20岁，身高约5英尺，面色萎黄，身穿灰色长衫，西式长裤。
2) 男性，年龄约17或18岁，身高约5英尺，面色萎黄，身穿灰色长衫和一双 Basket shoes（音译：篮式鞋/便鞋）

探访结束离开监狱时，他们登上了8路电车，并在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与外滩的拐角处下车。随后两人沿爱多亚路步行至四川路，进入四川路1号，该处由特许证券物品交易所占用。截至下午5点30分监视结束时，这些人尚未离开该大楼。怀疑两人均受雇于上述场所。

D. S. Tcheremshanaky
D. S.

1933年5月15日 特别支部主管警官。

Tseu Kwei Ling (周奎麟).
Liuho. made self.
Central Stn. 26-4-32. xxxxxxxx Clerk Yang Kyung Jung.
translated

My name is Tseu Kwei Ling, age 28, a native of Liuho, and I came to Shanghai in January, 1921. I was then employed as an assistant in the Chartered Stock and Produce Exchange, No. 1 Szechuen Road at a salary of $39.60 per month. I was married and had one child and they lived with my parents and my younger sister in the country. I reside at Room 57, No. 1 Szechuen Road. I am not connected with any political organizations or labour unions.

In February this year, when I was in the Bund Garden, I met one named "Jong" who told me that he was a broker in a book shop but was unemployed at present. At that time the Sino-Japanese trouble was on at Shanghai. This man informed me that he was not satisfied with the present Chinese government. But I did not sympathize with him regarding what he told me. He got my address from me and later he used to communicate with me by letter. But later on he sent to me by post the printed matter such as "Lenin Youth" etc. However, I did not know his address.

In the afternoon of the 26th inst., when I was working in the Exchange some Police officers came in and asked for me. I admitted that I was the man they were looking for. They also searched my room and found some printed matter therein, some of them I had not even read over so I did not know what were the nature of the contents.

I was working in the Exchange and I was always busily engaged in my work so there was a very little chance for me to do anything else or to meet persons outside. I did not join any unlawful activities. All my statements could be verified by the senior officers of the Exchange.

Made and signed by:-
Tseu Kwei Ling.
Witnessed by C. D. C. 86
Chang Hsiao Ling.

周奎麟（Tseu Kwei Ling）。
六合人。自述。
中央巡捕房，1932年4月26日。xxxxxxxx 书记员杨庆荣（Yang Kyung Jung）。
译毕

本人名叫周奎麟，现年28岁，籍贯六合，于1921年1月来到上海。当时受雇于四川路1号上海证券物品交易所，担任助理员，月薪39.60元。本人已婚，育有一子，他们与我的父母及妹妹一同居住在乡下。本人现居住于四川路1号57室。本人未参加任何政治组织或工会。

今年二月，本人在外滩公园时，遇见一名自称“Jong”（音译）的人，他告诉我说他是一家书店的经纪人，但目前失业。当时上海正值中日纠纷之际。此人告知我，他对当前的中国政府感到不满。但我对他所说的话并不表示同情。他将我的地址要去，后来便通过书信与我联系。但随后他通过邮局寄给我一些印刷品，如《列宁青年》等。然而，我并不知道他的地址。

本月26日下午，当我在交易所工作时，几名警员进来找我。我承认我就是他们要找的人。他们还搜查了我的房间，并在其中发现了一些印刷品，其中有些我甚至未曾阅读过，因此我不知道其内容性质如何。

我在交易所工作，一直忙于公务，因此很少有机会做其他事情或在外与人会面。我没有参与任何非法活动。我的所有陈述均可由交易所的高级职员核实。

立据并签字人：
周奎麟。
见证人 C. D. C. 86
张孝林（Chang Hsiao Ling）。
